# lettermint_domain_verification (Resource)

Waits until Lettermint has verified a domain's DNS records. Create it after the records from lettermint_domain.dns_records exist in DNS. If Lettermint later reports the domain as pending or failed, the resource is planned again and the next apply re-verifies. Destroying it changes nothing in Lettermint.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "lettermint_domain_verification" "example" {
  domain_id  = lettermint_domain.example.id
  depends_on = [cloudflare_dns_record.lettermint]

  timeouts = {
    create = "20m"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) Id of the lettermint_domain to verify.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as domain_id.
- `status` (String) The domain's status after verification: verified, or partially_verified when only recommended records are missing.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import lettermint_domain_verification.example 0199aaaa-0000-7000-8000-000000000001
```
